result_summary.title: Wrong tenant data shown and access denied errors in SSO Production
result_summary.description: Users in our US-East production environment are reporting that the SSO Integration Module is displaying data from the wrong tenant. Additionally, they are receiving unexpected 'permission denied' and 'access denied' errors when trying to perform actions that should be authorized. This is affecting 297 users with high business impact. We need to isolate if this is a session caching issue or a permission mapping error.
